mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_approval_mappings ( erp_menu_id, erp_source_id, daou_document_id, daou_form_code, status, draft_user_id, title, content_html, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{erpMenuId}, #{erpSourceId}, #{daouDocumentId}, #{daouFormCode}, #{status}, #{draftUserId}, #{title}, #{contentHtml}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_approval_mappings SET daou_document_id = #{daouDocumentId}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE erp_approval_mappings SET title = #{title}, content_html = #{contentHtml}, status = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{status}), ''), status), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND UPPER(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('WRITING', 'TEMPSAVE', 'DRAFT')
